mechanism_read: The learned retrieval metric did not break the retrieval family. Surface validity, change-law realism, and cross-cell structure remain intact.
The collapse happened because the future target for metric learning used only future changes. That target is too level-free for deterministic Stage A selection.
The next clean fix is to keep learned retrieval but train it on a richer future representation that carries both local changes and anchored cumulative displacement.
